### Century Communities Celebrates Grand Opening of Lakewood Heights, a New Home Community in Marysville, Washington


September 30, 2026


Priced from the high $600s, single-family floor plans at the community offer 4 to 6 bedrooms


**KEY TAKEAWAYS**


- **Grand Opening Event:** Century Communities hosted the Grand Opening of Lakewood Heights in Marysville, Washington, on September 26, from 10 a.m. to 6 p.m., featuring tours of the new Noah plan model home.
- **Floor Plans Offering Room to Grow:** Lakewood Heights offers six single-family floor plans ranging from 2,164 to 3,392 square feet, priced from the high $600s. Select plans offer finished basements, main-floor bedrooms, and covered patios.
- **Neighborhood Recreation & Gathering Spaces:** The community will feature more than seven acres of open space plus a walkable design with approximately 1.5 acres of planned active recreation, including parks, open green spaces, a grass volleyball court, a multi-purpose sports court, and horseshoe pits.
- **Connected Location:** Lakewood Heights sits approximately two miles from I-5, 15 miles from downtown Everett, and 20 miles from the Boeing Everett/Paine Field area.


MARYSVILLE, Wash.


, Sept. 30, 2026


/PRNewswire/ -- **Century Communities, Inc. (NYSE: CCS)—** a top national homebuilder, industry leader in online home sales, and featured on America's Most Trustworthy Companies by Newsweek—recently celebrated the Grand Opening of Lakewood Heights, a new community in Marysville priced from the high $600s. Located in North Snohomish County with convenient access to I-5, Everett and major regional employment centers, Lakewood Heights pairs versatile floor plans with more than seven acres of open space and a future 1.5 acres of recreational amenities.


**Learn more, explore available homes, and contact the sales team at**[www.CenturyCommunities.com/LakewoodHeightsGO](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4786716-1&h=3678141335&u=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.centurycommunities.com%2FLakewoodHeightsGO&a=www.CenturyCommunities.com%2FLakewoodHeightsGO)


The Grand Opening celebration took place on Saturday, September 26, from 10 a.m. to 6 p.m. Attendees toured the merchandised Noah plan model home, explored available homesites and floor plans, and enjoyed festive, fall-inspired bites and beverages. Interested homebuyers who weren't able to attend the Grand Opening are encouraged to make an appointment for a private tour. Walk-ins are also welcome.


"Lakewood Heights offers Marysville buyers modern new floor plans with flexible features that expand home space and possibilities, such as finished basements," said Mick Cermak, Washington Division President. "Plans for open space and outdoor amenities make the community ideal for those looking for quality homes in a location with room to breathe."


All six floor plans feature open-concept living spaces, gourmet kitchens with spacious islands, quartz countertops, luxury vinyl-plank flooring, deluxe primary baths, flexible loft and bonus room designs, and the Century Home Connect® smart home package. Select plans add main-floor bedrooms, finished basements, and covered patios.


**LAKEWOOD HEIGHTS | MARYSVILLE, WA** *Priced from the high $600s*


- Six single-family floor plans ranging from 2,164 to 3,392 square feet
- 4 to 6 bedrooms, 2.25 to 3.75 bathrooms, and attached 2-car garages
- Open-concept layouts with gourmet kitchens, deluxe primary baths, quartz countertops, Century Home Connect® smart home package, and more
- Walkable community design with more than seven acres of open space and approximately 1.5 acres of planned active recreation, including parks, open green spaces, a grass volleyball court, a multi-purpose sports court, and horseshoe pits
- Eight miles from downtown Marysville with easy access to employment and entertainment hubs
- Convenient proximity to local schools, I-5, Everett and major North Snohomish County employment centers


**Community Location** 1125 172nd Street NE
Marysville, WA 98271
425.599.2211

**FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS**


**Question:** What is Lakewood Heights?
**Answer:** Lakewood Heights is a new single-family home community by Century Communities in Marysville, Washington, offering six floor plans from 2,164 to 3,392 square feet, priced from the high $600s.


**Question:** When was the Grand Opening event?
**Answer:** The Grand Opening took place on September 26, from 10 a.m. to 6 p.m., at 1125 172nd Street NE, Marysville, Washington 98271.


**Question:** What floor plans are available at Lakewood Heights?
**Answer:** Lakewood Heights offers six two-story floor plans: Ponderosa, Finley, Noah, Rose, Luna Basement, and Noah Basement.


**Question:** Do the homes at Lakewood Heights offer any special features?
**Answer:** Homes at Lakewood Heights feature a range of exciting details, such as deluxe primary baths, gourmet kitchens, quartz countertops, walk-in closets, and more.


**Question:** What amenities does Lakewood Heights offer?
**Answer:** The community plans to offer more than seven acres of open space and approximately 1.5 acres of active recreation, including parks, open green spaces, a grass volleyball court, a multi-purpose sports court, and horseshoe pits.


**About Century Communities** Century Communities, Inc. (NYSE: CCS) is one of the nation's largest homebuilders and a recognized industry leader in online home sales. Newsweek has named the Company one of America's Most Trustworthy Companies for four consecutive years. Through its Century Communities and Century Complete brands, Century's mission is to build attractive, high-quality homes at affordable prices to provide its valued customers with A HOME FOR EVERY DREAM®. Century is engaged in all aspects of homebuilding — including the acquisition, entitlement and development of land, along with the construction, innovative marketing and sale of quality homes designed to appeal to a wide range of homebuyers. The Company operates in 16 states and over 45 markets across the U.S., and also offers mortgage, title, insurance brokerage, and escrow services in select markets through its Inspire Home Loans, Parkway Title, IHL Home Insurance Agency, and IHL Escrow subsidiaries.
